bagPolicy.summary: Oversized bags, including luggage and large backpacks, are prohibited unless medically necessary. All bags are searched; the venue does not list an exact maximum dimension.
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.summary: Evening-show paid parking begins at 5 p.m. near the Opry House; follow Opry House Paid Parking signs. A prepaid pass permits one entry and one exit.
parking.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

rideshare.summary: The Opry’s published Opry House directions and FAQ pages do not state a dedicated rideshare pickup point.
rideshare.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

concessions.summary: Sound Bites counters on both lobby floors sell sandwiches, flatbreads, snacks, desserts, soft drinks and alcohol from doors until 30 minutes before the show ends. Outside food and drinks, including water, are prohibited.
concessions.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

accessibility.summary: Wheelchair accessible seats are on the upper and lower levels, with wheelchair lifts serving second-level seating. Use the Accessibility option when buying through AXS.
accessibility.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

reEntry.summary: The venue states that all exits are final and does not issue smoking passes.
reEntry.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

ticketPickup.summary: Collect Opry House will-call tickets at the Opry Box Office with a valid photo ID and confirmation number; tickets for shows at the Ryman are picked up there instead.
ticketPickup.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

gates.summary: Enter Opry House performances through the doors along the front of the building. Security screens guests and checks bags at entry.
gates.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.
